notes.title: New eSports Manager DevLog is live!
Game Development News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Some time earlier we asked you (on our Discord server) whether we should to start crowdfunding campaign or not. Most of users who voted were agree so we did it.

We created Patreon page where you can see planned development Roadmap, sponsorship tiers & benefits. Also there already is Development Inside post available to patrons of any level. Feel free to support our game project ;)

Patreon page: https://www.patreon.com/eSportsManager

Roadmap (Direct link: https://i.ibb.co/xHV5WWF/roadmap.png)
